name: Flanker and sleep quality: trial-level data and questionnaire
description: Trial-level data from a Flanker task (24 participants, 48 trials each) and the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index of the same participants. One row per trial in the Flanker file, one row per participant in the PSQI file.
measurementTechnique: Flanker task (E-Prime); Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI)
author: TODO

variableMeasured.name: cond
variableMeasured.description: Flanker condition. Coding: congruent = flankers match the target; incongruent = flankers differ from the target.

variableMeasured.name: sesso
variableMeasured.description: Sex. Coding: F = female; M = male.

variableMeasured.name: psqi_tot
variableMeasured.description: PSQI global score (Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index). Missing values: 99.
